CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid container templates maintained by Rafael Vieiras (https://github.com/rafaelvieiras).
Apps in this repository: - M3m0s: long-term memory for LLM agents (MCP, CLI and an embedded WebUI) over one local SQLite database. Source code and support: https://github.com/rafaelvieiras/m3m0s - Tinyfin: a Jellyfin-compatible media server in one Go binary, shipped with the Jellyfin web UI and jellyfin-ffmpeg. An API-only variant is published as Tinyfin API. Source code and support: https://github.com/rafaelvieiras/tinyfin - MyMediaDB: a self-hosted media catalog that scans library folders, matches titles against TMDB, TheTVDB and MusicBrainz, and keeps every field editable by the owner. Source code and support: https://github.com/rafaelvieiras/my-media-db
Each app has its own XML file under templates/ and its own support link, so bug reports go to the project repository. All projects are open source (MIT) on GitHub under the same maintainer account.
